text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. These goals help teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to achieve. It is also important to define milestones and deliverables so that progress can be tracked step by step. Milestones mark key moments in the project, while deliverables are the actual results you produce. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial: everyone involved should agree on the goals from the beginning. When all these elements are in place, projects run more smoothly and are more likely to succeed.
